description: One tree and the answer every reader of 'which project does this directory act on' must give for it. Paths are relative to the scratch base. 'project' is the nearest project store (null: none, refused); 'main' is the main checkout of the repository (null: no repository). Readers: the Node invocation-root door (test/rust-host/invocation-root-table.test.mjs), the Rust host walk (apps/fgos/src/cli_projector.rs tests) and the identity crate's main root (packages/identity/rust/tests/project.rs). 'policyRows' go beyond the walk: each names a policy and an optional --dir (absolute from the base when 'dirIsRelativeToBase', else as written) and expects either a root with 'found' or a refusal whose message contains 'refusal' ({base} stands for the scratch base). Readers: the Rust door (packages/git/rust/src/invocation_root.rs tests) and its Node adapter (the Node test above); the host walk and the identity crate read 'rows' only.

rows.name: linked worktree, which carries no store
the home directory, whose .fgos is the global directory

policyRows.name: caller-tree: a nested repository never takes the store of the project above it
caller-tree: a plain directory below home never takes the global .fgos of home
caller-tree: --dir is taken as given, even home
main-checkout: from a linked worktree the main root
main-checkout: --dir names another project and is taken as given
main-checkout: outside any repository the directory itself, whose store is not looked for
main-checkout-only: from a linked worktree the main root
main-checkout-only: another repository as --dir is refused
policyRows.refusal: is not the main checkout of the repository at

policyRows.name: main-checkout-only: outside a repository is refused
policyRows.refusal: it is not inside a Git repository

policyRows.name: main-checkout-only: outside a repository with --dir is refused too
policyRows.refusal: it is not inside a Git repository

policyRows.name: strict-cwd: the top level of a repository
strict-cwd: a subdirectory of a repository is refused naming its top level
policyRows.refusal: is inside the repository whose top level is "{base}/home/proj"

policyRows.name: strict-cwd: the top level of a linked worktree, which carries no store
strict-cwd: a directory outside any repository
strict-cwd: a directory holding a store outside any repository
